title: cynoglossum turcomanicum
intro: Cynoglossum turcomanicum, commonly known as Turkmen forget-me-not, is a flowering plant species in the borage family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum turcomanicum involve its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
